posts.trend: Indian Techies Returning From US Face Tough Hiring Market And Lower Pay
posts.context: US tech returnees face domestic pay cuts and tight hiring markets in 2026.
posts.angle: The timeline you built in 2018 assumed the domestic market would wait for you.
slides: In 2018 you left for San Jose to save for a 3BHK.

At 26: "Five years in Dollars, then buy property in Gurgaon."
At 33: "Six months in a managed stay, evaluating options."
The 3BHK now belongs to a 28-year-old who never left.
posts.caption: Every NRI group chat has one person quietly asking for internal transfer contacts.
posts.rank_verdict: The middle slide feels like a neat structural layout rather than an organic escalation.
